If ISM doesn't work for index and snapshot management, you can use Curator instead. It oﬀers
advanced ﬁltering functionality that can help simplify management tasks on complex clusters. Use
pip to install Curator:
pip install elasticsearch-curator
You can use Curator as a command line interface (CLI) or Python API. If you use the Python API,
you must use version 7.13.4 or earlier of the legacy elasticsearch-py client. It doesn't support the
opensearch-py client.
If you use the CLI, export your credentials at the command line and conﬁgure curator.yml as
follows:
client:
hosts: search-my-domain.us-west-1.es.amazonaws.com
port: 443
use_ssl: True
aws_region: us-west-1
aws_sign_request: True
ssl_no_validate: False
timeout: 60
logging:
loglevel: INFO
